body:
The web item dialog gives no feedback when a save is rejected. Example: type a
price of "1,50" (comma decimal — the natural EU input) → the server 422s
(invalid_price), performSave's exception escapes unhandled, the dialog just
stays open with no message; the only trace is the tiny header status flipping
to "Sync failed". The user has no idea what's wrong or that nothing was saved.

Android solved exactly this (ItemFormViewModel.parsePriceAmount /
parseCurrency): it normalizes "1,99" → "1.99", strips currency symbols and
whitespace, validates the 3-letter currency code, and shows inline field
errors BEFORE pushing — because a 422'd push also wedges the queue (T-32).

Fix (parity):
- port the normalization + validation to the web dialog (price amount,
  currency) with inline error text under the fields;
- catch onSave rejections in ItemDialog.performSave and surface the ApiError
  message inline instead of letting it escape as an unhandled rejection.

relates: T-88 (same component; do together or in sequence).

Files: web/src/components/ItemDialog.tsx (+ test).
title: Web: item dialog swallows save errors — no inline price/currency validation (Android has it)
